Witajcie! W najbliższych czterech miesiącach mam przerwę między swoimi stałymi projektami i dysponuję dostępnością.

​Jestem aktorką, wokalistką i tancerką– wychowałam się w teatrze, a na co dzień gram w filmach i serialach. Zagralam główna rolę m.in w "Chleb i sól". Z przyjemnością dołączę do ciekawych, rozwijających projektów (film,  teatr, projekty niezależne oraz komercyjne).
​Szukam wyzwań, w które będę mogła włożyć  swoje doświadczenie, wszechstronność i  zaangażowanie. 

Z wielką chęcią spróbuję także swoich sił w dubbingu.

Demo: https://youtu.be/cXgT79ZeZ3c?is=FpdVFHAxz66d0PoB 

​📩 Chętnie odpowiem na wszystkie pytania i wyślę swoje materiały w wiadomości prywatnej.
​Do zobaczenia na planie lub w teatrze!

Nikola Raczko

items.text:
NYC actors, does anyone else forget how their face works the second a camera comes out?

Perfectly normal all morning. Suddenly you’re trying to convey “approachable, but has a secret” while remembering where your chin goes.

I’m Akiyo, an actor and headshot photographer. I used to hate feeling like I had to arrive at a shoot as some fully realized, marketable version of myself.

Before coffee, apparently.

That’s a big part of why I started shooting.

We start with conversation, music, and a quick breathing reset. There’s time to settle in before you’re expected to do anything.

I’ll give you direction, but you don’t need to perform confidence or apologize when something feels awkward. We can work with however you’re showing up that day.

items.title: PAID CASTING CALL

items.text:
Paid Casting Call for a Permanent Main Cast Role in my Miro-Budget Indie Web Series

Evangaline the Black Mage--Main Character Role-long term, Permanently Position.

Pay Rate:

£15 per hour starting from the first hour when we start filming and ending on the last hour when we have stop filming. Overtime payment is included.

Acting Description:

You'll be following my instructions during each Scene/Take as we film. Showing Body Language, Facial Expressions, and Fighting in a RPG gameplay style. You must have a good memory when saying your lines.

Filming Location(s): 

All over Milton Keynes.

The first 2 locations to start us off filming is The Plough Pub in Simpson, follow by The Crauford Arms Pub in Wolverton.

Sometimes outside of Milton Keynes if I can not find a good filming location within the area. And most times film locations need to be specific in the right film set.

How many days of Filming:

Minimal of 1 day per month. I try and do multiple days per month but it get's hard to arrange and organize a Film Date based around everyone's rota's.

Travel Payment:

Your Travel fee(s) will be covered by me coming and going from Milton Keynes but you will have to show some proof of your journey so I can give the right amount to cover your Travels.

Food and Drinks:

Food and Drinks will be provided by me, but I don't bring food and drinks since the Team has been ok bringing there own. If we are near a Local Shop, Café, Coffee Shop, or even a Fast Food Restaurant, ect. Just let me know what you like and I will pay for you.

Evangaline Character Description: 

Full Name: Evangaline Springbell

Age: 19

Class: Black Mage-(Elemental Spellcaster)

Weapon(s): Fans and Rods-(Maybe)

Character Appearance:

She wears a big Leather Brown Wizard Hat with a big Red Ribbon to the side of the Belt Buckle, a Neck Choker, and a smooth Summer Red and Black Tartan Dress with a thin small Black Jacket.

She has Black Leggings with Red and Black Socks on and her hair colour changes sometimes to match her emotions.

Her alternative clothes is a Red and Black Hell Bunny Dress. (DLC idea I have used in the past.)

Character Bio:

Evangaline is a skilful Black Mage who uses Black Magic Spells that are a variety of Elemental and Destructive Power.

She is strong-willed, courageous, and has a strong sense of determination to punish those who commit evil deeds on others with her Black Magic. Even if they are her allies and friends which makes her quite scary.

At times she losses' her cool and get's angry sometimes, losing her temper and casting a Fire Magic Spell on others, especially on Zorran who annoys her and sexualised her for being a good looking woman. Making her very fierce and those who cross her will pay with there life.

she is a bit tomboyish, imposing, sharp-tongued, and extremely blunt, always blurting what she truly thinks and feels like without reservation, even if said comments come at others' expense. She makes it a personal philosophy to always be honest as it feels better.

Relationships with other Main Characters:

(Renzu)---She has a very healthy friendship and respect to Renzu the Main Hero of the Story (Protagonist) after he helped her out for being framed for a crime she did not commit without judging her. Evangaline over time starts to development feelings towards him but still treats him like any other typical Boy as they are the same age and that Evangaline has never spent so much time with a Boy before.

(Zorran)---She doesn't like him all that much for being a drunken, lazy, childish, and perverted older man. When Zorran slaps her bum she sets his hand on fire with a fire magic spell which Zorran never learns from. Evangaline has to keep her guard up around him all the time as Zorran is unpredictable.

(Drako)--She feels Drako's pain after he lost his loved one to a Troll Monster, although Drako hasn't been part of the team for that long and she doe's not know him all too well but she enjoys his fighting spirit and resolve and get's along well with him 2nd to Renzu. Evangaline doe's not get why Drako likes Zorran that much or why his calling him "Master". She thinks he is a bit naïve.

What I'm looking for:

A Female Actress who is Capable, Committed, Not in full Education, Fit for the role, Flexible with her Rota, and is able to travel to Milton Keynes. And can travel to other locations outside Milton Keynes.

Age: 18-24

Height: 5.1 foot to 5.8 foot

Skin: White

Hair Colour: Any.

Body Type: Slim Build, Chubby, Athletic

Acting Requirements: Everybody is welcome, show me what you can do and what you know based on your Acting Experience.

Nationality: White British. Other White or British Nationality are welcome within reason.

I'm willing to let 1 or 2 slide if you don't meet the requirements, the rest will come down to a finale decision as I can't make any mistakes as this role is very important to be filled. If you don't think you can do this or can't handle it then best to step down from applying.

How to apply:

You can send a message to me directly. We can talk first, exchange information and contacts maybe, I will answer some questions that you wish to know or what I have missed in this Casting Call but not too many please as it saves time and I want to save my breath in answering questions and providing more info to those who are actually serious about this Post (No time wasters please).

After a few steps I'LL arrange a time and date to meet face to face with you if you live in or near Milton Keynes or by Video Call if you live far away like London. The chat will be about 1 hour and 30 mins.

If you are traveling to meet me in person your Travel Cost will be covered coming to Milton Keynes and going back home, which I will provide a fair sum for the time you have taken to see me on your journey.

Looking to continue filming with are new Actress as Evangaline ASAP.

Link to my Series on YouTube: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL5A8Ih2U1y15yAfFecmlZ4q_QsdmDLCXT&si=zU8XrRNGpXokHSDY

Thank you for taking the time to read this.

Branded Promo Talent, a leading experiential marketing agency, is seeking reliable, enthusiastic, and professional Brand Ambassadors to represent TD Bank at Boston Celtics and Boston Bruins home games at TD Garden in Boston, MA!

Event 1: Celtics

Friday, October 23, 2026

3:00 PM – 9:00 PM (TBC)

Event 2: Bruins

Saturday, October 24, 2026

3:00 PM – 9:00 PM (TBC)

Location:

TD Garden

100 Legends Way

Boston, MA 02114

Compensation:

Team Lead — $35 per hour

Brand Ambassadors — $30 per hour

— 1099, paid weekly —

Parking:

Parking reimbursed with receipt.

Attire:

Branded t-shirts will be provided. Wear black pants (no leggings, sweatpants, or ripped/torn jeans) with clean, comfortable white sneakers. Long-sleeved black or white layers may be worn underneath the branded shirt, and black jackets are permitted as needed for colder weather.

Event Details: 

TD Bank is bringing game-day excitement to TD Garden for back-to-back home games featuring the Boston Celtics on Friday and the Boston Bruins on Saturday! Brand Ambassadors will be stationed throughout the exterior plaza and indoor concourse areas, engaging with fans, creating personalized player trading cards, and assisting with interactive games.

Team Lead Duties: 

• Must have experience leading large teams. 

• Oversee staff and coordinate team assignments. 

• Ensure smooth event execution and client communication. 

• Capture event photos and submit recaps.

Staff Duties:

• Assist with event prep, execution, and breakdown to ensure smooth operations.

• Engage with fans, communicate key brand messaging, and guide guests through the activation. 

• Maintain a fun, welcoming, and energetic atmosphere to create memorable fan experiences. 

• Support event activities, manage guest flow, and assist with giveaways.

Staff Expectations: 

We want high-energy, outgoing, and engaging Brand Ambassadors who know how to hype a crowd and create great vibes. You must be punctual, professional, and ready to bring it from start to finish!

Application Process:

To be considered, email chrissy@brandedpromotalent.com with the following:

• Availability

• Resume

• Headshot

• Relevant experience

• A brief description of why you're an excellent fit for this role.

Please use "TD Garden - Celtics & Bruins" as the subject of your email.

Note: Only applicants who follow all instructions will be considered. Our team will review qualifications via email and schedule a call with eligible candidates.

We are working with the lovely team at Raw Research casting an exciting ITV x PayPal Christmas campaign, and we’re looking for bubbly, fun-loving families (e.g. adult siblings, adults with their parents, couples with children aged 16+, friends and housemates who love Christmas and go the extra mile to make it memorable. We’re particularly keen to hear from adults in their 40s and 50s - though all ages are welcome.

You might be a couple with children aged 16 or older, adult siblings, or grown-up children celebrating with their parents. Whatever your set-up, we’d love to meet people who enjoy a laugh, love ITV and already have plans for this Christmas.

We are looking for people who are London-based or about 90 minutes outside of London.

Do you have a Christmas dilemma we could help with?
Perhaps your adult child has a new partner joining Christmas lunch and you have no idea what to buy them? Maybe you’re determined to surprise your mum or sibling but have run out of ideas? Or perhaps you want to make a friend’s Christmas extra special and need some inspiration!

We’d ideally spend a day filming at your home, having fun planning presents, putting up decorations and calling ITV for help with your Christmas dilemmas. There may even be a quiz about ITV presenters, so a love of ITV and a willingness to be a bit silly are essential!

Filming - Dates TBC but 5th or 6th OR 9th are 10th of November are likely.

Payment:
£350 per person, per filming day.
£2,000 per person if you appear in the final ad campaign.
£500 per household if filming takes place in your home.
Eligibility:
Everyone taking part must be aged 16 or over. Ideally adults in their 40s and 50s!
Participants must be eligible for a PayPal account and have used PayPal or be familiar with it.
Participants must have no adverse credit history, history of debt or financial vulnerability.
Participants must have no current or previous affiliations with competing financial brands.
Interested? Please contact casting@rawresearch.co.uk, telling us who you’d take part with, what makes Christmas special to you and the Christmas dilemma you’d love help with. Please also send a photo of everyone applying, a simple selfie will do!
Thank you

🎥POSZUKUJĘ GRUPY TANECZNEJ DO TELEDYSKU DISCO! 💃🕺🎶🎥
Cześć! 👋 Szukam 3–4 osób lub większej grupy tanecznej chętnych do wystąpienia w moim nowym teledysku disco polo! 🎤🔥

📍 Miejsce nagrania: Białystok

Najlepiej, jeśli zgłoszą się osoby z Białegostoku lub okolic.

📅 Termin: piątek(wiem,że późno😉)

🎬 Co trzeba zrobić? Zatańczyć do jednej lub dwóch piosenek. Chodzi o krótkie ujęcia taneczne, które zostaną wykorzystane jako przebitki w teledysku.

🎭 Pomysł na występ: planuję taniec w maskach, żeby stworzyć większe show i nadać klipowi wyjątkowy klimat! 😎 Dzięki temu wizerunek uczestników nie musi być pokazywany. Jeśli ktoś będzie chciał wystąpić bez maski i zgodzi się na wykorzystanie swojego wizerunku, również możemy to ustalić.

💰 Występ płatny – wynagrodzenie do uzgodnienia!

📩 Osoby zainteresowane zapraszam do wiadomości prywatnej. Ustalimy szczegóły, miejsce, godziny oraz wynagrodzenie.

**🎬 CASTING CALL **🎥

**FEATURE FILM CAST DESCRIPTION**

**TERROR IN TIMMONTON**

**An Independent Mystery / Suspense Feature Film**

**Production Company:** R&R Visionary Productions
**Genre:** Mystery / Suspense
**Production Type:** Independent Feature Film
**Union Status:** Non-Union
**Filming Location:** Waterloo / Cedar Falls, Iowa
**Filming Begins:** Summer 2027
**Projected Release:** 2028
**Casting Deadline:** October 31, 2026

**About the Film**

*She survived the nightmare. But what if leaving it behind only led her into another?*

After enduring more than eight years of abuse, Hailee finally escapes her troubled past, only to become the victim of a brutal attack that nearly takes her life.

While recovering in the hospital, she develops an unexpected friendship with a male nurse who offers her the opportunity to leave Arizona and begin a new life.

But her fresh start takes a mysterious turn when she discovers a hidden note behind a bedroom nightstand.

**"If you are reading this, that means I am dead. — Annalise."**

Determined to uncover the truth, Hailee begins asking questions about Annalise. However, the people around her claim to know nothing about the mysterious woman.

As secrets begin to surface, Hailee realizes that her new home may hold a disturbing past—and that some people will do anything to keep the truth buried.

**Compensation and Meals**

This is an **unpaid, volunteer-based independent feature film production**. There is no monetary compensation for acting roles.

Participants will have the opportunity to gain valuable on-set experience, develop their acting skills, build their portfolios, and participate in a full-length feature film.

**Lunch and supper will be provided at no cost to cast members on their scheduled filming days.**

**How to Apply**

Interested actors may submit through **Backstage** or email:

**[rrvisionaryproductions@gmail.com](mailto:rrvisionaryproductions@gmail.com)**

Please include:
* Your full name and contact information
* The character or role you wish to audition for
* A recent headshot or photograph
* Acting résumé or previous experience, if available
* Your anticipated availability during Summer 2027

**CASTING DEADLINE: OCTOBER 31, 2026**

**JOIN THE CAST!**

R&R Visionary Productions welcomes dedicated, enthusiastic individuals who are passionate about storytelling and independent filmmaking.

Help us bring the secrets, mystery, and suspense of *Terror in *

*Timmonton* to the big screen!

**R&R Visionary Productions**
*Bringing Stories to Life*

1. Zdjęcia w plenerze. Nagrania późnym popołudniem do nocy.

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy

5. Adres e-mail

6. Wzrost

7. Czy jest Pan/Pani dostępna/y w terminie 3.11-4.11?

8. Link do swojego profilu na Facebook/Instagram

9. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w planie zdjęciowym zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

***On recherche un comédien en vue du rôle principal masculin, 20-25 ans, pour un clip musical étudiant à Angers (Pays de la Loire, France)***
# 
**Le projet** : 

Clip musical appelé « Ok Ok Ok » du groupe "Fleuri Désert"
# 
**Cadre **: 

Projet pédagogique d'étudiants en Bachelor Réalisateur Monteur de l'école Studio M Angers.
# 
**Date du tournage **: 

Samedi 24 octobre 2026, journée et soirée, à Angers 
# 
⚠️ ***non défrayé*** ⚠️

**LE RÔLE **

Rôle principal, muet. Un jeune homme dont la vie lui échappe : il rate un rendez-vous avec une fille, puis un rendez-vous avec un employeur, et chaque échec l'enfonce un peu plus. Il en souffre, et ça doit se voir.
Le personnage met en images les paroles de la chanson. Tout passe par le visage, le corps et les réactions. Le ton est très théâtrale, presque exagéré par moment tout en étant capable de transmettre des émotions forte à d'autre moment. On cherche donc idéalement quelqu'un capable de jouer un personnage désemparé et d'aller loin dans l'expression sans que ça sonne faux.
Pas de danse
# 
PROFIL 

Homme, 20 à 25 ans.
À l'aise avec le jeu expressif et physique. Une expérience en théâtre, impro ou tournage est un plus.
# 
INFOS PRATIQUES

Il faut être disponible toute la journée et la soirée du samedi 24 octobre, à Angers (49).

# CANDIDATURE 

Par mail à [goldenlight.rh@gmail.com](mailto:goldenlight.rh@gmail.com?subject=Votre%20annonce%20dans%20cineaste.org%20#3628)
***Objet obligatoire : Casting Clip musical*** (car on recherche pour plusieurs projets en ce moment)
Joindre : une photo récente (visage et plein pied), votre âge, votre ville, et si possible un lien vers une vidéo de jeu.
Date limite : 14 octobre 2026

Clap&Light Productions ([goldenlight.rh@gmail.com](mailto:goldenlight.rh@gmail.com?subject=Votre%20annonce%20dans%20cineaste.org%20#3628))

items.text: Clowning is not purely for people who wish to be clowns or go into comedy; it's not even purely about ‘making people laugh’. It's a practice that can benefit any creative artist- actor, director, writer, etc.- by enabling them to achieve a level of honesty and playfulness that creates work unique to those who undertake the training

sharedPost.text:
An in-depth, serious and enjoyable exploration into the unlimited power of the state of clown and its impact on new and experienced clowns, actors, performers of all kinds, anyone who stands in front of an audience, and those seeking ways to be in the moment with confidence, authenticity and joy.
This is a transformatory course; by embracing the methodology, you will deepen your ability to enter and stay in the state of clown in whatever context you work. 
Transformation only comes with some effort, and the course is a process that will stretch you, but one based in support, kindness, and a great deal of fun, laughter and play along the way. 
Through led exercises, improvisations, games and explorations, de Castro expertly and safely guides participants through an individual and collective process. It invites you to try new things and make mistakes in a supportive environment. 
Come prepared for challenges and change.
We support and celebrate each participant’s journey of development.
𝗕𝘆 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗲𝗻𝗱 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝘄𝗼𝗿𝗸𝘀𝗵𝗼𝗽, 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝘄𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲: 
*explored the pleasure of being present;
*confidence in risk-taking & the freedom to fail ;
*how to use the audience as your partner;
*a strong understanding of your relationship with your 
*own clown persona, that is unique and individual to you;
*a toolbox of well-defined techniques to refine your performance skills on your own and in groups;
*knowledge of how to use clowning in acting, or in any creative work within other disciplines.
‘𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗧𝗼 𝗕𝗲 𝗔 𝗦𝘁𝘂𝗽𝗶𝗱’

For an application form: 𝘄𝗵𝘆𝗻𝗼𝘁𝗶𝗻𝘀𝘁𝗶𝘁𝘂𝘁𝗲@𝗮𝗼𝗹.𝗰𝗼𝗺

items.text:
Announcing auditions for:

The Savannah Sipping Society

By Jones Hope Wooten

Directed by Ben Green 

Auditions: Monday & Tuesday, October 26 & 27 @ 7:00pm

Callbacks by invitation Wednesday, October 28th @ 7:00pm

Please bring a headshot and resume and be prepared to read from the script

Please be prepared to list any and all conflicts

A hilarious, heartfelt comedy about friendship, second chances, and starting over. Four very different Southern women find themselves at a crossroads in life. After an unexpected meeting at a yoga class, they come together for an impromptu happy hour that blossoms into a weekly gathering filled with laughter, cocktails, romantic misadventures, and life-changing revelations. As they navigate personal setbacks and unexpected new beginnings, these women discover that it’s never too late to reinvent yourself—or find your people.

We are seeking four dynamic performers with strong comedic instincts, excellent timing, and the ability to balance broad comedy with genuine emotional depth. Distinct Southern character voices are required.

Performances: January 8 through 31, 2027

Thurs–Sat at 7:30pm

Sundays at 2:00pm

Saturday matinees January 16th and 30th at 2:00pm

Rehearsals at Cabrillo Playhouse in San Clemente, CA

We welcome and encourage performers of ALL races, ages, gender identities, abilities, body types and ethnicities to audition.

There is a $100 stipend offered

All audition info can be found at [https://cabrilloplayhouse.org/auditions-casting-call/](https://cabrilloplayhouse.org/auditions-casting-call/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgFicmlkETFycU1rOXdWUVQ3NVYwZTd5c3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHm2Tb8clJTpxO68zuvsQvksB_no2fy_0RkndZIF5-lmcuKAEritfk1H60_jt_aem_lUoHhYxjNHwOwByN68UZcg)

Announcing auditions for:

The Savannah Sipping Society

By Jones Hope Wooten

Directed by Ben Green 

Auditions: Monday & Tuesday, October 26 & 27 @ 7:00pm

Callbacks by invitation Wednesday, October 28th @ 7:00pm

Please bring a headshot and resume and be prepared to read from the script

Please be prepared to list any and all conflicts

A hilarious, heartfelt comedy about friendship, second chances, and starting over. Four very different Southern women find themselves at a crossroads in life. After an unexpected meeting at a yoga class, they come together for an impromptu happy hour that blossoms into a weekly gathering filled with laughter, cocktails, romantic misadventures, and life-changing revelations. As they navigate personal setbacks and unexpected new beginnings, these women discover that it’s never too late to reinvent yourself—or find your people.

We are seeking four dynamic performers with strong comedic instincts, excellent timing, and the ability to balance broad comedy with genuine emotional depth. Distinct Southern character voices are required.

Performances: January 8 through 31, 2027

Thurs–Sat at 7:30pm

Sundays at 2:00pm

Saturday matinees January 16th and 30th at 2:00pm

Rehearsals at Cabrillo Playhouse in San Clemente, CA

We welcome and encourage performers of ALL races, ages, gender identities, abilities, body types and ethnicities to audition.

There is a $100 stipend offered

All audition info can be found at [https://cabrilloplayhouse.org/auditions-casting-call/](https://cabrilloplayhouse.org/auditions-casting-call/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgFicmlkETFycU1rOXdWUVQ3NVYwZTd5c3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHm2Tb8clJTpxO68zuvsQvksB_no2fy_0RkndZIF5-lmcuKAEritfk1H60_jt_aem_lUoHhYxjNHwOwByN68UZcg)

We are currently looking for up to four actors to participate in our upcoming twilight spooky rides.
Here are the details for the position:

  - Dates: October 22, 23, 24, 29, 30, and 31

  - Hours: 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM (2 hours per day)

  - Pay: $50 per day (paid in cash)

  - Location: Silver Lake Railriders, 1381 Village Road, Silver Lake, NH 03875 (behind the Silver Lake Railroad Station)

Schedule & Responsibilities:

  - Station Actor (1): Remains at the station area and yard to haunt the arriving guests.

  - Trail Actors (3): At 4:00 PM, a rail motorcar will drop three actors off at designated acting locations along the route.

  - The Performance: The twilight railbike ride departs at 4:30 PM. Actors will scare guests on their way out and back. The rail motorcar will pick up the trail actors at the end of the run, returning everyone to the station around 6:00 PM for a final scare.

Requirements:

  - Safety rules must be strictly followed: no touching riders and maintain a safe distance from all equipment.

  - All actors (or parents/guardians for minors) must sign a standard liability release prior to participating.

I have created a spreadsheet to help organize and schedule interested actors. You can learn more about us at slrailriders.com.

Best regards,

Hank Walther

Rail Ventures

Silver Lake Railriders

🎬 CASTING CALL — FEMALE LEAD FOR MUSIC VIDEO
📍 Location: Warsaw, Poland

Dates: 19.10-22.10 (estimate) 

Mystique Studios is casting a female lead, age 26–30, for an upcoming music video production to be filmed in Warsaw, Poland.

We are looking for a woman with:

• East European look

• Natural, innocent features

• Expressive face and comfortable presence in front of the camera

• Acting/modeling experience is welcome, but not essential

• Ability to portray natural emotion, warmth and chemistry on camera

🎥 ABOUT THE PROJECT

The music album has already been released, and we are now producing an official music video intended for YouTube, social media promotion and submission to music video/film festivals.

The shoot will take approximately 1–2 days in Warsaw, Poland.

This is an independent, low-budget production, so please apply with this in mind.

💰 COMPENSATION

This is a paid role, with cash payment depending on the selected cast member, experience and final shooting requirements.

Food, snacks and drinks will be provided during filming.

🎞️ ABOUT US

We are an independent, low-budget production studio focused on films, music and visual storytelling.

Our work includes:

• 2 completed feature films produced for the festival festivals 

• One feature officially selected at 30+ film festivals across Europe and winner of 10+ awards

• 2 released music videos

• 10+ released music albums

• Several new film, music and visual projects currently in development

📩 TO APPLY

Please send:

• Your name and age

• Prefer location - Warsaw 

• 3–5 recent photographs — preferably portrait and full-length

• Links to Instagram or other social media

• Acting/modeling/showreel links, if available

• Brief details of previous experience, if any

WhatsApp: +48 579 162 415

Email: mystiquestudios@yahoo.com

Telegram: @Mystiquestudios

Please write “MUSIC VIDEO CASTING” when contacting us.

Selected applicants may be invited for a short meeting or camera test in Warsaw before final casting.

🎬 Mystique Studios

Independent Film • Music • Visual Storytelling

THESPIANS ARE ATHLETES. 💪🎭

Agree or disagree?

sharedPost.text:
THESPIANS ARE ATHLETES. 💪🎭

Agree or disagree?

Think about what we ask performers to do.

Sing while dancing. Execute choreography. Project energy to the back row. Repeat it eight shows a week. And make it look effortless.

That takes strength, stamina, coordination, and control.

But rehearsing a show isn’t the same as training your body to perform it.

That’s why I created inMOTION Studios.

Dance technique. Strength. Conditioning. Choreography. All designed to help musical theatre performers get better at what they do.

And the best part? You don’t have to miss rehearsal to train.

Our online training library lets you build the skills and stamina you need on YOUR schedule.

🎭 Rehearse the show. Train the performer.

Ready to build the body behind the choreography? Come train with us!

#ThespiansAreAthletes #MusicalTheatre #TheatreFitness #PerformerTraining #InMotionStudios

Hi everyone!

We have LOTS going on right now and several projects still open for casting.  See these THREE below that are currently still open!  Here are the details for each and the requirements for submission.  Please respond as requested if you are interested!!

1) SEEKING YOUNG GIRL FOR AUTOMOTIVE COMMERCIAL - DUE 10/19

Seeking talent for automotive commercial - Richmond VA - NU - Mid-November timeframe

Greetings everyone!  NEW PROJECT JUST IN!  Self tapes ARE required for consideration!  Please pass the word!

Here is what we know/need:

Project:  Haley Auto Group 60, 30, 15 and social.  Voice will also be used for radio

Location:  Richmond VA area

Date:  Mid-November (Exact date TBD)

Usage:   26 weeks broadcast with buyout for online and social

Rate:  $1,000.00 (less any fees)

Talent needed:

GIRL:  Age 6-10, Caucasian or Ambiguous/Mixed ethnicity.  The girl is supposed to be charming, competitive and nice, but kinda funny and bossy. We don’t want snotty or spoiled, but a little attitude would be fun! 

Submission Process/Auditions: Script can be seen in the link below. We’d like self-recorded video auditions.  Please slate with first and last name, then we'd like to see a full-body shot, then a medium shot so we can see their face for the performance of the lines. A headshot would be great too so we can present to the client (include in the video package).

Sides:  [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1u5w0EO9DzziYnEsHDZUOOgjwb_CYMRld?usp=sharing](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1u5w0EO9DzziYnEsHDZUOOgjwb_CYMRld?usp=sharing)

NOTE - ONLY DO THE :30 script for the audition!

Please combine your self tape slate, takes and headshots into 1 file and send to [bias@liquidtalentgroup.com](mailto:bias@liquidtalentgroup.com) by 6 pm on 10/19 (sooner is better).  Let us know if you have questions!

---------------------------------------------------------------------------

2)  SEEKING MULTIPLE TALENT FOR DUI PSA - DUE 10/19

Seeking talent for DUI PSA - Richmond VA - NU - DATE TBD Anticipated Mid-November

Hi everyone!  NEW PROJECT JUST IN!  SELF TAPES REQUIRED FOR THIS PROJECT!

Here is what we know/need:

PROJECT: Seeking talent for a DUI/Alcohol Safety Public Service Announcement (PSA). Specifics: 3 talent will have one line each. The other is a non-speaking principal. 1/2 day shoot per person.

DATE: Anticipated to be Mid-November (TBD) 

USAGE: 1 year for Virginia TV (with ability to renew), we'll also use the audio from the PSA for radio. Will also appear on social media & web.

RATE: $750 per speaking role, $500 per non-speaking role (less fees) - includes session and usage.  Half day shoot per person anticipated.

CHARACTERS:
* Bart / Bar Friend - male, late 20's/early 30s, non-black person of color (i.e. Middle Eastern, Hispanic, Indian, etc.). Friendly white-collar guy at the bar for happy hour
* Dan / Construction Boss - male, 40s, Black, working class because he runs a crew of construction workers and drivers.
* Emily / First Date - female, late 20's-30s, Caucasian or lighter-skinned, dressed for a first date, expressive.
* Andrew / Driver - male, late 20's-30s, Asian or Caucasian 

AUDITIONS: Below is the script and some audition notes. NOTE - On Page 2 of this package are specific instructions by role.  Please review these and make sure your audition adheres to them.

Client specified self-recorded video auditions, we'd like to see a full-body shot, then a medium shot so we can see their face for the performance of the line itself. A headshot would be great too so we can present to the client.  Please incorporate all of this into your video file if possible!

Be sure to slate with first and last name then role.  Then go into the actions as described in the information below.

Here is the link to the sides for each role.  

[https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1E0C392zKDPZMTZoi8JAr7QPIXAHpUwy0?usp=sharing](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1E0C392zKDPZMTZoi8JAr7QPIXAHpUwy0?usp=sharing)

Send your 1 self tape to [bias@liquidtalentgroup.com](mailto:bias@liquidtalentgroup.com) via WeTransfer by 6 pm on 10/19 - sooner is better.  Let us know if you have any questions!

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

3) SEEKING MULTIPLE TALENT FOR LAW FIRM COMMERCIAL - Due 10/18

Seeking talent for law firm project - NU - Richmond VA - Self Tapes Required!

Greetings everyone!  NEW PROJECT JUST IN!

Here is what we know / need:

Context:  Law Firm commercial shoot

Location:  Richmond VA area

Shoot day: Wednesday Oct. 21st

Talent Roles:

1. Mom - 35-45 - Any ethnicity
2. Dad - 35-45 - Any ethnicity
3. Child - 8-10 yrs old - Any ethnicity
4. Woman - 50s - Hispanic or African American 

Rate: 

$1,200 adults + 20% agency fee - (1) :30 second spot - usage one year TV/Streaming and paid online VA regional (Richmond, Charlottesville, Fredericksburg, Petersburg markets) 

$700 child + 20% agency fee - (1) :30 second spot - usage same as above 

Travel Stipend: $250 a person (negotiable)

Submission process:

Client has requested a self tape for consideration for these roles.  Here are the instructions:

–Slate first and last name then location

–For any of the family roles (#1-3) - talent should tell us a their favorite story, one happy and one sad, but not too long, just a minute on each. 

–For the individual female role (#4) - talent should do the same as above but not too long so she can act out a scene.  The scene is as follows:  talent is sitting with the attorneys and then hearing the news that they have won the case, so we can see her reaction. She will sit down and then stand up and hug the attorney. 

Note - please feel free to submit as a group as you meet the breakdown for the family roles.  Just ensure that all individuals provide the requested information.

Please send 1 self tape via WeTransfer to [bias@liquidtalentgroup.com](mailto:bias@liquidtalentgroup.com) by 5 pm on Sunday 10/18.  Sooner is better!

**CASTING CALL: *****SEVEN DEUCE***

**Format:** Short Film / 1970s Neo-Noir Crime Thriller

**Location:** Watkins,CO

**Shoot Dates:** November 14th and 15th

**Pay:** Paid / Non-Union Meals, Footage, and Credit provided

**Logline:** In 1975, a fortified, high-stakes underground poker game spirals out of control when greed, blackmail, undercover surveillance, and paranoia explode into a bloody 3:00 AM standoff.

**OPEN ROLES**
* **SEAT 1: THE NAMELESS VET (Male, 30s)**
* Lean, hardened, haunted. A Vietnam veteran with a dead-eyed thousand-yard stare and lethal military stillness. Speaks in a flat, quiet rasp. Economy of movement; thinks like an ambush survivor.
* **SEAT 2: JIMMY "SPRINTS" (Male, Late 20s–Early 30s)**
* Gaunt, manic, hyperactive, constantly drenched in sweat. A compulsive degenerate gambler in way over his head with loan sharks. Swings wildly between manic euphoria and breathless terror. Big physical and emotional range.
* **SEAT 3: AGENT KANE / "MILLER" (Male, 30s)**
* Sharp, handsome, tailored, cool under pressure. An undercover federal agent wearing a wire, desperately trying to keep his cover intact while counting down the minutes to a tactical raid. Needs an exceptional, subtle poker face.
* **SEAT 4: LEONARD SMOOTHS (Black Male, Late 30s–Early 40s)**
* Tall, imposing, velvet street elegance. A charismatic, stylish pimp with an icy, calculating demeanor. Commands the room with a smooth baritone, but possesses explosive, bare-knuckle violence when pushed.
* **SEAT 5: FRANK "NUMBERS" (Male, 50s–60s)**
* Broad, gravel-voiced mob veteran with horn-rimmed glasses and cold calculation. Treats the high-stakes game like an accounting spreadsheet. The calmest, smartest criminal in the cellar.
* **SEAT 6: RAY "SOLLY" SULLIVAN (Male, 40s–50s)**
* Heavyset, greasy, sweat-soaked, brutal. A deeply corrupt detective who uses his badge as a weapon of extortion and street bullying. Vicious, loud, remorseless, and arrogant.
* **THE DEALER (Female or Male, Late 30s–40s)**
* Sharp, immaculate, surgical. Total mechanical precision with cards and zero visible emotion. Commands absolute authority over dangerous, armed men through icy house rules.
* **WALTER / THE HEAVY (Male, 40s–50s)**
* Imposing, broad, weathered 230+ lb enforcer guarding the cellar door with a shotgun. A man of few words with terrifying physical presence.
**HOW TO SUBMIT**

Please email your **Headshot, Resume, and Reel (or self-tape link)** to:

📧 **tyler.j.stewart14@gmail.com**

**Subject Line:** *7DEUCE - [Role Name] - [Your Full Name]*

*Sides and self-tape instructions will be sent upon review. Feel free to share or tag talent who fit these period roles!*

**SEEKING ACTORS FOR STUDENT PRODUCED TELEVISION SHOW**

**Title:** The Bluffs: Season 13

**Genre:** Dramedy

**Logline: **A punk rocker down on his luck and his funds starts rigging bets using UCCS’s new betting app to pay his mounting pile of bills.

**Roles: **

**HAYDEN: (18-24 YEARS OLD) - MALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

A STRUGGLING PUNK ROCK MUSICIAN. REBELLIOUS AND IMPULSIVE, HE IS TORN BETWEEN BEING FINANCIALLY STABLE AND LIVING AN AUTHENTIC PUNK LIFESTYLE ***THIS ROLE REQUIRES SINGING**

**GRACE: (18-24 YEARS OLD) - FEMALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

HAYDEN’S BEST FRIEND, ROOMMATE, AND BANDMATE. SHE IS QUIETLY CONFIDENT AND HAS A STRONG SENSE OF HER OWN MORALS. VERY PUNK.

**DARBY: (18-24 YEARS OLD) - FEMALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

HAYDEN’S COWORKER WHO IS IN A COMPETING PUNK BAND, ALTHOUGH YOU PROBABLY WOULDN’T KNOW THAT BY LOOKING AT HER. VERY BUSINESS MINDED, SHE IS MORE INTERESTED IN BEING A MUSICIAN FOR THE MONEY AND CLOUT THAN FOR THE ARTISTIC EXPRESSION.

**JP: (30-50 YEARS OLD) - MALE, ANY ETHNICITY**

HAYDEN AND DARBY’S BOSS AND THE BRAIN BEHIND UCCS’ NEW BLUFFBETS APP. A MIDDLE-AGED TECH BRO WHO DESPERATELY TRIES TO BE HIP AND APPEAL TO HIS STUDENT EMPLOYEES.

**Production Company:** UCCS Digital Filmmaking Program

**Production Type: **Student Television Show

**Contact Information:** vsmith@uccs.edu

**Run Time: **Television Show, three 10ish minute episdodes

**Compensation: **Unpaid

**Union Status:** Non-Union

**Audition Information:** October 24th from 2 pm to 7 pm at UCCS, by appointment only: 

https://calendly.com/vsmith-uccs/bluffsseason13audition

Shooting Schedule:

October 31st, 9AM-7PM

November 7th, 9AM-7PM

November 14th, 9AM-7PM

November 21st, 9AM-7PM

December 5th, 9AM-7PM

December 12th, 9AM-7PM

December 19th, 9AM-7PM

***Shoot dates called will depend on the role. Please look at each character to see how frequently we expect you to be called based on the character you audition for**

**Filming Location:** Various, mostly on the UCCS campus, every location with be in Colorado Springs.

**Project Description:** Every year, the UCCS Digital Filmmaking program produces a three episode anthology television show called The Bluffs. Students write, film, and edit the show from start to finish.

🎬 **CASTING CALL – DAY PLAYERS & FEATURED SUPPORTING ROLES**

**A MEASURE OF DIGNITY – British Feature Film**

🎥 **Production:** Northline Pictures
🎬 **Produced & Directed by:** Matt Walker & Leton Tarafdar
📍 **Filming Location:** North East Lincolnshire
📅 **Planned Filming:** Spring 2027

Northline Pictures is seeking actors for a range of speaking, featured non-speaking and voice-over roles in our upcoming independent British feature film, *A Measure of Dignity*.

The film follows a former boxer struggling to rebuild his life, confront his past and become the father his young daughter needs.

We welcome submissions from experienced actors, emerging performers and suitable newcomers.

**ROLES AVAILABLE**

**1. FAMILY COURT JUDGE**
A composed, authoritative and perceptive judge presiding over emotionally difficult family-court proceedings. Substantial dialogue requiring gravitas, compassion and a commanding presence.

**2. WALTER**

🎬 **A QUICK NOTE REGARDING CASTING & PAYMENT**
We'd like to clarify that **all roles in *A Measure of Dignity* are paid positions**.
As this is an independent British feature film being produced on a modest **£55,000 budget**, we want to be completely transparent that our guaranteed fees are lower than standard industry rates.
However, alongside the agreed upfront payment, we are also offering **backend profit participation**, giving cast members the opportunity to benefit financially if the film generates distributable profits.
We've allocated **35% of Producer's Net to our cast** and a further **15% to our crew**, with individual percentages agreed according to roles and responsibilities.
Backend payments are not guaranteed, but we believe it's important that the people helping bring this film to life have an opportunity to share in its potential success.
We fully appreciate the time, talent and commitment involved in filmmaking, and we understand that our fees may not suit everyone.
Our aim is to create a professional, collaborative production where everyone is treated fairly, paid transparently and valued for their contribution.
Thank you to everyone who has auditioned, applied or expressed an interest in joining us.
**Northline Pictures** 🎬
*A Measure of Dignity*

HO HO HO! We’re looking for Father Christmas! 🎄

Wish Upon a Star Productions & Events Ltd is seeking talented, charismatic and experienced performers to bring the magic of Christmas to life at a festive experience in Preston, Lancashire, this December!

🎄 A professional, reliable and enthusiastic approach.

🎄 Access to a high-quality Santa costume would be advantageous.

🎄 Availability for all/multiple dates is highly desirable, although applications for individual dates are welcome!

Working hours:

Full event days: 10:30am–9pm

🎅🏻 Whether you own a professional Santa costume

wishuponastareventsltd@gmail.com

Help us create unforgettable Christmas memories for hundreds of families this festive season! ❤️

Wish Upon a Star Productions & Events Ltd
Where the magic comes to life! ✨

CASTING CALL: Singer / Actor / Performer
Company: Midnight Creative

Pay: $300 per day

Job Type: Paid Performance Opportunity

Work Location: South Florida

Job Description

Midnight Creative is seeking talented singers, actors, and performers to join our growing roster of immersive theatrical productions.

Our shows combine live theater, dramatic storytelling, music, and audience interaction to create unique entertainment experiences.

We are looking for versatile performers with strong stage presence, expressive acting abilities, and the confidence to captivate an audience through both musical performances and spoken monologues.

Opportunities are available across multiple productions, including Edgar Allan Poe: The Musical, Edgar Allan Poe Speakeasy, and other immersive theatrical experiences.

Responsibilities

* Perform scripted monologues, dramatic scenes, and/or original musical numbers, depending on the production and assigned role.

* Bring characters to life through expressive acting, vocal delivery, and compelling storytelling.

* Learn and memorize scripts, dialogue, and music within designated preparation periods.

* Engage audiences in an immersive theatrical environment.

* Collaborate with fellow cast members and the production team.

* Attend required rehearsals, training sessions, and performances.

* Maintain professionalism, punctuality, and reliability throughout each production.

What We’re Looking For

* Strong acting skills and confident stage presence.

* Ability to deliver engaging, emotionally compelling spoken monologues.

* Strong vocal ability for musical roles (all vocal ranges welcome).

* Excellent memorization skills and the ability to learn material quickly.

* Clear diction, vocal projection, and expressive character interpretation.

* Ability to take direction and adapt to different characters and production styles.

* Experience in musical theater, dramatic theater, cabaret, or immersive performances is a plus.

* Reliable, professional, and comfortable performing in front of live audiences.

Please note: Not all roles require singing. We welcome applications from experienced actors, vocalists, and versatile performers. Casting assignments will be based on individual strengths and production needs.

Compensation

$300 per performance day.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should send the following materials to gio@rockstarbeer.com:

* Performance résumé (if available).

* Headshot or recent photograph.

* Acting reel, spoken monologue, or vocal performance video (if available).

Email Subject: Casting Submission – Singer / Actor / Performer

Selected candidates may be invited to audition with a prepared spoken monologue, musical selection, or both, depending on the role.

Poszukujemy Statystów w wieku 18-70 lat (kobiety i mężczyzn) z Kielc lub okolic na plan zdjęciowy do spotu reklamowego dla znanej sieci restauracji w Kielcach w dniach 3.11, lub 4.11 (wtorek lub środa).

1. Zdjęcia w plenerze. Nagrania późnym popołudniem do nocy.

2. Wynagrodzenie za 1 dzień zdjęciowy: 150 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po planie zdjęciowym — BLIK na numer telefonu/konto bankowe).

W razie zainteresowania i dostępności w dniach 3.11 lub 4.11 prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy

5. Adres e-mail

6. Wzrost

7. Czy jest Pan/Pani dostępna/y w terminie 3.11-4.11?

8. Link do swojego profilu na Facebook/Instagram

9. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Plan zdjęciowy Kielce

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w planie zdjęciowym zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

🎬🎬🎬 MEGA ULTRA PILNE! CASTING! 🎬🎬🎬

EPIZODYSTKI I EPIZODYŚCI – ROLKI / TIKTOK / IG

Szanowni Państwo!

Na środę, 21 października 

poszukujemy epizodystek i epizodystów 

do krótkiej formy komercyjnej realizowanej 
na potrzeby kanałów TikTok i Instagram (IG).

🎥 KOGO SZUKAMY?

✅ Kobiet i mężczyzn w wieku 25–50 lat 

✅ Osób polskojęzycznych 

✅ Osób posiadających doświadczenie w pracy przed kamerą

Poszukujemy osób do wielu różnych ról, 
które wcielą się w postaci pracowników 
i klientów marketu.

💰 WYNAGRODZENIE: 500–1000 zł netto

Stawka uzależniona jest od przypisanej postaci i zakresu roli. 
Po zakwalifikowaniu zgłoszonych osób 
do konkretnych postaci skontaktujemy się 
z wybranymi osobami i poinformujemy je 
o proponowanej stawce.

📍 MIEJSCE REALIZACJI: Warszawa

📅 TERMIN: środa, 21 października 

🕘 GODZINY: pierwsza połowa dnia

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?

Osoby zainteresowane i dyspozycyjne prosimy 
o przesłanie zgłoszenia w wiadomości e-mail 

na adres:  📧 abcastingab@gmail.com

📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭

W zgłoszeniu prosimy wpisać:

• Temat: ROLKI  21. 10
• Imię i nazwisko
• Wiek
• Numer telefonu
• Zdjęcie twarzy oraz zdjęcie całej sylwetki
• Informację o doświadczeniu w pracy przed kamerą
• Linki do materiałów wideo, na których można Państwa zobaczyć i usłyszeć

🎬 Poszukujemy osób do wielu postaci — jeśli masz doświadczenie przed kamerą i jesteś dyspozycyjny/a w środę, serdecznie zapraszamy do zgłoszeń!

Do zobaczenia na planie! 🎥🤝

Do pierwszego odcinka 2. sezonu serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję kobiet do nastepujących ról:

1.Roksana (19) – młoda, ładna, pracuje w kawiarni jako barmanka/baristka. Dziewczyna z problemami psychicznymi.
Data: 26 i 27.10
Stawka: 1600 zł netto

2.Joanna (37) – przeciętna kobieta z przemocowej rodziny, zaniedbana, wystraszona   
Data: 27.10
Stawka: 800 zł netto

3. Śledcza (37) – zadbana śledcza, konkretna, rzeczowa.
Data: 30.10
Stawka: 500 zł netto

4.Iwona (41) – kobieta po stracie dziecka, załamana, rozbita, wrak człowieka. Chorobliwie szczupła i zniszczona problemami.  
Data: 30.10
Stawka: 700 zł netto

Chętne Panie zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

items.text:
Call for Participants: Staged Reading Theatre Workshop

Are you an aspiring or experienced actor with lived experience of addiction?

“Saving the Timothy” — A Modern Retelling of “A Christmas Carol”

The Recovered Arts Collective is seeking actors for an upcoming staged reading of Saving the Timothy, a new dramatic comedy written and directed by John-David Hutchison.

We also require Stage Manager, Assistant Director, Lighting & Sound Technicians

About the Project
We are bringing together a community of people with lived experience of addiction to participate in developing this new play. This project will culminate in a staged reading—a live performance where actors read the script with minimal sets, props, or costumes. Performers focus on character development, vocal expression, and text interpretation in a supportive, low-pressure environment.

Logline
A washed-up, addiction-ravaged Hollywood director returns to his small-town Canadian theatre roots to stage A Christmas Carol, where the specter of his late partner forces him through a dark, hallucinatory journey across his past, present, and future toward 12-step redemption and sobriety.

Who Can Join & What to Expect
Inclusive Community: Everyone is welcome! Whether you are a seasoned creative or have never stepped foot on a stage before, no previous experience is required—just a willingness to share your story and connect.

Supportive Environment: A peer-led space focused on safety, creative expression, personal growth, and building lasting relationships.

Collaborative Process: Work together to bring personal and community stories to life, culminating in a public staged reading performance.

Key Dates & Location
Audition / Table Read: Sunday, November 1, 2026, 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Rehearsals: Sundays (November 8, 15, 22, 29), 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM
Performance: Sunday, December 6, 2026 (Time TBD)
Location: The Vancouver Recovery Club, 2775 Sophia St, Vancouver, BC

How to Apply / Audition Instructions

To be considered, please fill out the Google Form https://forms.gle/ZDC2c8M5xwWVjiPn7 
or submit an introduction letter, headshot/selfie & resume/experience to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org  by October 30, 2026 

Character Breakdown
Eban Miser: A once-prominent Broadway and Hollywood director who, after facing bankruptcy, career failure, and struggles with alcoholism and drug addiction, returns to his hometown to direct a local production of A Christmas Carol and undergoes a redemptive journey toward sobriety.

Jake O'Connor/The Ghost of Christmas Future: Eban's late business partner and co-founder of the Timothy Findley Theatre, who dies broke and unaccomplished, but happy and whose reanimated corpse warns Eban to change his destructive path.

Bob Cratchit: Eban's loyal and hardworking stage manager at the theatre, who later becomes an equal partner and helps care for Timothia.

Fred: Eban's cheerful and persistent nephew who repeatedly invites him to holiday gatherings and tries to show him goodwill.

Clara: Fred's wife and member of the theatre troupe

Bill (The Ghost of Christmas Past): A calm, guiding figure who leads Eban through his spectral journey 

Fan: Eban's late sister.

Mr. Fezziwig: Eban's enthusiastic high school gym teacher who features in his past memory of a school dance.

Patricia: Eban's former fiancée who broke off their relationship because he abandoned their shared values for the pursuit of wealth.

Belle: Eban's former partner who left him because of his unaddressed alcoholism.

Emily: Bob Cratchit's sharp-tongued wife who helps run the household and cares for Timothia.

Timothia: Jake’s sullen 15-year-old orphaned daughter who lives with Bob and Emily.

Jack: The abusive stepfather from Eban's childhood.

Craig: Belle's husband.

Nancy, Topper, and Friends: Members of the theatre troupe
Roastmaster and 3 Roast Comics: Roasters of Eban (These four roles are specifically for comedians who will assist in the writing of the roast dialogue.)

This is a volunteer opportunity and you must be committed to the rehearsal schedule.

How to Apply / Audition Instructions

To be considered, please fill out the Google Form https://forms.gle/ZDC2c8M5xwWVjiPn7 
or submit an introduction letter, headshot/selfie & resume/experience to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org  by October 30, 2026 

Casting selection will be through the table read.

Questions? Reach out to hello@therecoveredartscollective.org with the subject line "Staged Reading Inquiry."

items.text:
Jigsaw Casting is seeking Canadian User -generated videos that show a ‘winning moment’ in life for a LOTTO 649 campaign done through TBWA\Canada (address: 219 Dufferin Street, Suite 302C, Toronto, ON, M6K 3J1/Tel: 416.483.3600/[https://tbwa.ca/](https://tbwa.ca/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgFicmlkETFaZzlmNFdiS1JOMTRibVNkc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABHifDGia4LsOANDG_Ih2ltQT9AaeTz2u2uhuNe4hNlIgkWLvv1Kcxh0Qp2M2Z_aem_X_R1CiZkB1duyws1Eg9Ziw)) (Excludes submissions from the province of Quebec)

We are looking for those moments that feel like someone is coming out on top. Your video clips should have a range of emotions. Some are fist pumping celebrations (i.e. catching a baseball). Others are beautiful, heartfelt moments (i.e. someone asking out his crush and getting her number, or someone getting married and it was a very emotional romantic moment).

We’ll prioritize a broad range of Canadian experiences and affinities, from fishing and outdoor activities to sports, city moments, friendships, family and romantic relationships.

Canadian-shot content only: All footage must be filmed in Canada. Canadian creators are preferred, and recognizable non-Canadian locations/backdrops should be avoided. Generic footage from a Canadian creator that does not reveal an identifiable foreign location may be considered subject to client approval.

What we are looking for:

Our clips also fall into two camps: The Win and The Agency.

The Win
This shows the moment people come out on top.
For example:
→ Pulling a giant trout from the water
→ Catching a home run baseball in the stands

The Agency
This shows a moment of doubt, hesitation, or choice.
→ A moment before their hole-in-one swing, a friend saying they can’t make the shot.
→ Someone getting egged on before they go on stage and slay at karaoke.
→ Someone is deliberating doing that cliff dive. Do they vs don’t they.

If you have another footage that is a wild card, it may not fit the above specs, you can still submit it.

🎬 **CASTING CALL – A MISTAKE (Short Film)**

Hi everyone! We're looking for two actors for our upcoming **7-minute short film**, *A Mistake*, shooting in Central Burnaby on **October 29**.

**LOGLINE**
Two friends bond over the struggles of dating and being single while on a hike, but things take an awkward turn when one jokingly suggests they start dating each other and the other doesn't take it well.

**ROLES**

**BEN | Late 20s | Open ethnicity**
A bit awkward, literal, and straightforward, with a dry sense of humour. Ben and Sarah were friends in high school but drifted apart after graduation. He's been single for a while and figures he has nothing to lose by jokingly suggesting they start dating, but the conversation takes an unexpected turn.

**SARAH | Late 20s | Open ethnicity**
Outgoing and sociable, Sarah works as a schoolteacher and has an easy warmth about her. She's been single for a while and struggles to process or identify what she's feeling, particularly when it comes to relationships. She and Ben were friends in high school but drifted apart before reconnecting after college. The hike serves as a chance for them to catch up.

**PRODUCTION DETAILS**
📍 Location: Central Burnaby, BC
📅 Shoot date: October 29, 2026
💰 Compensation: Volunteer, with demo reel material, photos, IMDb credit, and food provided on set
🎭 Open to UBCP/ACTRA members and non-union performers
📩 Submission deadline: October 20, 2026

**HOW TO APPLY**
Please email your headshot, demo reel (if available), and resume to **amistakeshortfilm@gmail.com**. We are also open to first time actors and those who have had no formal training. 

Use the subject line: **[Your Name] – [Character Name] Audition**

Shortlisted applicants will receive **self-tape instructions**. Feel free to share with anyone who might be a good fit. Thanks!

sharedPost.text:
Hi everyone! 👋

I know this is very last minute, but sometimes the best opportunities come together at short notice! 🎬

If anyone is free this evening, it would be brilliant to have you involved and help bring 6 HALFS to life. It’s a great chance to get on set, meet others and be part of the journey as we continue building this project.

If you can make it, please email me at Petersinseeya2@gmail.com to let me know.

No worries if you can’t make it this time, there will hopefully be more opportunities ahead.

Thanks again for all your support. Let’s keep building something special together! 🙌🎥

**The Actor's Lab Online / Private Coaching for Actors**

**With 35+ years of experience in the Los Angeles market as an acting coach, mentor, and founder of The Actor’s Lab, I know what it takes to move an acting career forward. Talent is essential, but building a successful career requires more: the right guidance, a strategic approach, and a strong understanding of both the craft and the business of acting.**

**Through my private online coaching, I work one-on-one with actors to sharpen their skills, identify opportunities, overcome career challenges, and develop a focused strategy to take their careers to the next level.**

**My private coaching rate is $125 per hour.**

**I look forward to connecting with you.**

**J.D. Lewis **
**The Actor's Lab **
**(310) 621-3900**
**TheActorsLab@me.com**
**[www.TheActorsLab.com](https://www.TheActorsLab.com)**

Are you an actor who overthinks every choice you make?
Maybe you struggle to feel “present” when you’re acting, and can’t get out of your head.

(That’s exactly how I felt when I left drama school by the way)

Introducing the Meisner Technique!

Meisner works on training you to get out of your head, and work from one impulsive moment to the next. And here’s your chance to try it with our online taster.

How much? £10
Where? live on Zoom. 
Next one - Wednesday 18 November.

Most of us are told to "be in the moment". Very few are shown how to through developing my a reliable, world class technique.

It's the training behind legends like Diane Keaton, Robert Duvall, Gregory Peck, Grace Kelly and Jeff Goldblum, who all studied with Sanford Meisner in New York.

I'm Adam Stadius. I've spent over twenty years in UK training actors, I’m from Durham originally, though now I’m based in Leeds, where I’m deputy Head of Leeds Conservatoire’s School of Drama. As a Meisner teacher I’ve taught in (and trained actors from) pretty much every major UK drama school, and I’m passionate about actors in the north of England being able to access quality training.

So do come along! no experience needed.

items.text:
🛝 A little playground stop on the way home from the girls’ gig today!

LA traffic can be SUCH a burn, so it's nice to find a neighborhood park and let everyone get some energy out before getting back on the road. 😂

Our GPS was taking us right by this one anyway, so why not?!

Today has been a LOT of driving, which means I haven't been able to post nearly as much as usual!

BUT! I'm really excited because I'm starting two new series this weekend! ❤️

🎬 LITTLE STARS: Getting Your Kids Into Acting & Modeling
Starting tomorrow! I'll be sharing what I've learned, how we got started, and tips for parents who are interested in getting their own little ones into the industry.

💰 FROM POSTS TO PAYCHECKS: Facebook Monetization 101
Starting Sunday! Everything I've learned about growing a Facebook page, getting monetized, and actually making money from your content. Including all the trial and error it took to get here! 😂

I'm definitely not an expert on everything, but I've learned a LOT through both experiences, and I'd love to help other parents get started!
If either of these interests you, follow along! ❤️

And please drop any questions you have! I'd love to work them into the series.

Selected talent will submit photographs and videos according to specific guidelines. Still images will be used to generate AI video content.

Film Krótkometrażowy Niekomercyjny
Szukamy osób pełnoletnich (18+) do udzielenia krótkiej wypowiedzi głosowej (audio) do autorskiego filmu krótkometrażowego (projekt realizowany z myślą o międzynarodowych festiwalach filmowych).

📅 Kiedy: Sobota, 17 października 2026 r. o godz. 17:00 📍 

Gdzie: Gdańsk (szczegóły podamy w wiadomości prywatnej)

Będzie to wywiad wyłącznie głosowy (bez nagrywania twarzy przed kamerą!).

Na czym polega zadanie? To bardzo krótka, kameralna i bezstresowa rozmowa mikrofonowa. Zadamy trzy krótkie pytania:

„Czego szukamy w galerii handlowej? Po co tu przychodzimy?” (odpowiedź na 1–2 zdania).

„Czego nam brakuje w tej obfitości?” (odpowiedź na 1 zdanie).

„Gdy myśli Pan/Pani o swojej pracy w tym całym technologicznym pędzie, to jakie jedno słowo przychodzi jako pierwsze?” (tylko jedno słowo, np. szybciej, targety, zmęczenie, powiadomienia).

Zostało nam kilka miejsc na jutrzejsze warsztaty Tworzenia Kremów dla Pań z Agnieszką Roguską Royal Academy Centrum Gimnastyczne podczas Moc Kobiecości - Różowa Wstążka 2026! Darmowe wejściówki są dostępne na stronie mok-kobylka.pl/bilety/

17:00 „Nowotwory – lepiej zapobiegać niż leczyć” – prelekcja z Urszulą L Kwiatek\
18:00 „Rak piersi bez tabu – rozmowa z męskiej perspektywy” – panel dyskusyjny
z Radiologiem Lek. med. Marcinem Grzebykiem i Marcinem Lasotą organizatorem wydarzenia Zastrzel Raka 
18:45 Warsztaty doboru bielizny w profilaktyce walki z rakiem piersi z Madame bra by Blanka 
19:15 „Głos kobiet, siła doświadczeń” – Szczere rozmowy z kobietami, które przeszły chorobę nowotworową, o doświadczeniach, emocjach, sile i znaczeniu wsparcia. Prowadząca: Blanka Gankowska – wstęp wolny
a na wielki finał o godzinie 20:00 czeka na Was koncert Paulina Stekla!

What do casting directors REALLY notice when you walk into a dance audition?
We’re bringing award-winning Pearson Casting to Liverpool for an exclusive Audition Technique for Dancers Intensive!

Experience a mock professional dance audition, learn choreography and receive honest, constructive feedback from the other side of the casting table.

Discover what casting directors look for, how you come across in the room, what makes you memorable and why getting the choreography wrong isn’t always the biggest issue.

Plus, a Q&A with Pearson Casting, giving you the chance to ask those all-important industry questions.

With credits including SIX, Operation Mincemeat, Starlight Express, RENT and High School Musical, this is an incredible opportunity for North West performers to learn directly from an award-winning international casting team.

Monday 7th December | Liverpool

3-hour intensive | £25

No job on the line. Just the opportunity to learn, make mistakes and grow.

Bookings: https://bookwhen.com/wirraltowestend

This workshop adheres to CDG guidelines and is not an audition.

Wirral To West End

🎬 CASTING / POSZUKUJEMY 2 MODELEK / AKTOREK DO NAGRYWEK REELS  DLA HOTELU ****
Do udziału nagraniach wideo dla 4-gwiazdkowego hotelu w centrum Gdańska poszukujemy dwóch doświadczonych modelek / aktorek, które wcielą się w role dwóch przyjaciółek.

KOGO SZUKAMY?

💃🏻💃🏻2 KOBIETY (rola: przyjaciółki / duo)
 
• Wiek wizualny: ścisłe 35–40 lat (Bardzo prosimy o samokrytykę i zgłoszenia wyłącznie osób wpisujących się w ten przedział wiekowy.) 

• Uroda: naturalna, dojrzała, elegancka. Warunek konieczny: zero widocznych zabiegów medycyny estetycznej.

• Wymagane: realne doświadczenie przed kamerą / w wideo, swoboda oraz umiejętność budowania naturalnej relacji na planie. 

SZCZEGÓŁY PLANU:
📍 Lokalizacja: Gdańsk (Centrum)
📅 Termin zdjęć: [28 lub 29.10.]
💰 Wynagrodzenie: Płatne 

JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?
Prosimy o zgłoszenia według briefu
z dostępnością terminów. Zgłoszenia 
przyjmowane są w wiadomości prywatnej (PRIV) i powinny zawierać:

1. Imię, nazwisko, wiek
2. Wzrost, dokładne wymiary oraz rozmiar odzieży / obuwia
3. Kilka aktualnych zdjęć (twarz bez filtrow / mocnego makijażu + sylwetka)
4. Materiały wideo (wideo-wizytówka, showreel lub krótkie nagranie przedstawiające sylwetkę i emocje przed kamerą)

Czekamy na Was w wiadomościach  - odezwiemy się do wybranych osób. 
Do zobaczenia na planie! 🤌💫

S.

items.text:
Cześć!!! 🎬🎥
Do najnowszego odcinka Trudnych Spraw, poszukiwani odtwórcy poniższych ról:

1.BORYS GABRYSIAK (45) – gangster i wierzyciel Jakuba. SCENY: 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11 – 7 scen. 
INTRO: 1.
Wygląd: Przypakowany, tatuaże, ostentacyjny „osiedlowy gangster”; dres, złoty łańcuch, rzucający się w oczy zegarek.
Szczegóły: Czarny charakter, ale nie karykatura. Groźny, bezczelny, inteligentny i zdolny błyskawicznie wykorzystać cudzą słabość. Przy Julii potrafi udawać sympatycznego, co wymaga dobrego przełączania energii aktorskiej.
📆26-28.10

2.BARBARA NOWACZYK (54) – matka Jakuba. 
SCENY: 7, 9, 10, 14, 16, 25, 26 – 7 scen.
Wygląd: Sterana życiem 54-latka, mogąca wyglądać nieco starzej. Po udarze konieczna wiarygodna zmiana fizyczna.
Szczegóły: Kochająca, ale wielokrotnie zawiedziona przez syna. Aktorka musi bardzo dobrze zagrać stan po rozległym udarze: początkowo ciężki niedowład lewej strony, potem stopniową poprawę. W scenie 25 dochodzą problemy z chodzeniem, a w 26 stan jest już znacznie lepszy.
📆26-27.10

3.ADAM JABŁOŃSKI (27) – znajomy Jakuba z dawnego środowiska. 
SCENY: 18, 19 OFF – 2 sceny.
Wygląd: Typ osiedlowego drobnego kombinatora, sportowy styl. 
Szczegóły: Kusi Jakuba możliwością szybkiego, nielegalnego zarobku. W scenie 19 występuje wyłącznie głosem przez telefon.
📆27-28.10

4.JERZY NOWACZYK (57) – ojciec Jakuba. 
SCENY: 20, 21 – 2 sceny.
Wygląd: Zaniedbany, zniszczony alkoholem mężczyzna. Szczegóły: Manipulant i oportunista. Powinien początkowo sprawić wrażenie człowieka, który może rzeczywiście martwić się o Barbarę, aby późniejsze ujawnienie jego prawdziwych intencji zadziałało.
📆27-28.10

5.WALDEMAR MOREŃ (30) – biologiczny ojciec Julii, były mąż Doroty. 
SCENY: 22, 23 – 2 sceny.
Wygląd: Dobrze ubrany 30-latek, pod którego normalnym wyglądem kryje się agresor. 
Szczegóły: Podpity, agresywny i przemocowy. Musi być wiarygodnym zagrożeniem dla Doroty, ale zgodnie z charakterem pasma nie powinien być przerysowany.
📆26.10

6.ADRIANNA LASOTA (60) – sąsiadka Barbary. 
SCENA: 12 – 1 scena.
📆26.10

📍Wrocław 

💸gotówka po planie 

📩Zainteresowane i dostępne osoby proszę o kontakt w wiadomość prywatnej.

🎤 12-WEEK BEGINNER SINGING COURSE- FREE TRIAL! ONLINE 🎤

Always wanted to learn to sing but not sure where to start?

I’m running a small 3-month online beginner singing course for adults— perfect if you’d love to develop your voice, build confidence and understand how to sing with better technique, all from the comfort of your own home.

Over 12 weekly sessions, we’ll work on:

Breathing & posture
Pitch & vocal technique
Range & resonance
Registers & rhythm
Articulation & phrasing
Musical expression & confidence

The sessions are friendly, supportive and completely beginner-friendly. No previous singing experience is needed.

👥 Small group

📅 FREE TRIAL SESSION: 22nd October

ACTORS; are you looking for some help with your acting career? Maybe things are feeling stale for you, and want some feedback on your showreel, or maybe you’re an aspiring actor who doesn’t know where to start and would benefit from guidance!

We are here for you!

TakeTwo is the screen acting company run by myself, Emma Hollywood, and my actor friend, Elena Pitsiaeli. Together, we have over 15+ years of experience in this industry, and credits including BBC Doctors, Hollyoaks, West End’s “The Little Big Things” as well as lots of short film experience.

As actors ourselves, we know how isolating this industry can be, and how now, it’s more important than ever, to have like minded people by your side to steer you in the right direction, have a fresh eye on your showreel and help to build up your career.

WHAT WE OFFER:
👩‍💻40 minute online sessions on Zoom, open to actors worldwide
📸On camera acting techniques and industry advice, completely tailored to your level and goals
✉️Advice on approaching agents and industry professionals
🎥Confidence building for those who struggle with feeling self conscious when self taping
📆Flexible dates and times for you to book. We also happily work round different time zones if you’re not from the UK
💷No commitment, meaning you pay for each session as you book. There’s no membership or rule of committing to a certain amount!

⭐️ We’re proud to share that every actor who has attended a session with us has chosen to become a regular client, continuing to invest in themselves and take their career to the next level!

We offer a completely FREE online consultation to those who are interested in these sessions, so you can meet us and discuss your goals before deciding whether to book!

If you’d like to book a consultation, or would simply like to know more about us, please send us a message on here or Instagram!

Instagram: @taketwoacting

🎬✨

**STATISTER SØGES TIL AFGANGSFILM – DEN DANSKE FILMSKOLE**

Til afgangsfilmen *ANGELS*, instrueret af Jonatan Egholm Keis og produceret af Astrid Andreasen, søger vi statister af alle typer, køn og aldre til at agere familiemedlemmer/venner til et sølvbryllup.

**Dato:** Torsdag d. 15. oktober

**Tidsrum:** ca. 09.00-19.00

**Sted:** Storkøbenhavn

Lyder det som dig - eller kender du nogen? Så hører vi meget gerne fra dig!

Send en mail til statisten.nu@gmail.com med navn, alder, kontaktoplysninger og et vellignende billede.

Hvis du er under 18 år bedes du desuden angive navn og kontaktoplysninger på en forælder/værge.

Skriv: FESTGÆST i emnefeltet.

*OBS: Kun henvendelser via mail vil blive besvaret.*

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

***Om filmen***

*ANGELS er en rockerfilm uden læderveste, motorcykler, narko og pistoler. Det er en moderne gangsterfilm til den tid, vi lever i, som fokuserer på mennesket bag den kriminelle etikette.*

Deltagelse er ulønnet, men der vil være forplejning på set.

We are working with the lovely team at Raw Research casting an exciting ITV x PayPal Christmas campaign, and we’re looking for bubbly, fun-loving families (e.g. adult siblings, adults with their parents, couples with children aged 16+, friends and housemates who love Christmas and go the extra mile to make it memorable. We’re particularly keen to hear from adults in their 40s and 50s - though all ages are welcome.

You might be a couple with children aged 16 or older, adult siblings, or grown-up children celebrating with their parents. Whatever your set-up, we’d love to meet people who enjoy a laugh, love ITV and already have plans for this Christmas.

We are looking for people who are London-based or about 90 minutes outside of London.

Do you have a Christmas dilemma we could help with?
Perhaps your adult child has a new partner joining Christmas lunch and you have no idea what to buy them? Maybe you’re determined to surprise your mum or sibling but have run out of ideas? Or perhaps you want to make a friend’s Christmas extra special and need some inspiration!

We’d ideally spend a day filming at your home, having fun planning presents, putting up decorations and calling ITV for help with your Christmas dilemmas. There may even be a quiz about ITV presenters, so a love of ITV and a willingness to be a bit silly are essential!

Filming - Dates TBC but 5th or 6th OR 9th are 10th of November are likely.

Payment:
£350 per person, per filming day.
£2,000 per person if you appear in the final ad campaign.
£500 per household if filming takes place in your home.
Eligibility:
Everyone taking part must be aged 16 or over. Ideally adults in their 40s and 50s!
Participants must be eligible for a PayPal account and have used PayPal or be familiar with it.
Participants must have no adverse credit history, history of debt or financial vulnerability.
Participants must have no current or previous affiliations with competing financial brands.
Interested? Please contact casting@rawresearch.co.uk, telling us who you’d take part with, what makes Christmas special to you and the Christmas dilemma you’d love help with. Please also send a photo of everyone applying, a simple selfie will do!
Thank you

items.text:
Mezinárodní filmový festival BRNO16 se řadí mezi nejdéle fungující filmové festivaly v České republice. Od svého založení v roce 1960 se koná nepřetržitě a zároveň patří k nejstarším přehlídkám krátkometrážní tvorby na světě. Představuje široké spektrum krátkých filmů, od hraných a animovaných až po experimentální snímky, a to jak od studentů, tak od profesionálních i neprofesionálních tvůrců. Vedle prestižní filmové soutěže nabízí také bohatý doprovodný program zahrnující výstavy, diskuse a workshopy. Festival každoročně hostí řadu českých i zahraničních osobností, které návštěvníkům umožňují nahlédnout do zákulisí své tvorby a diskutovat o filmech i zkušenostech z filmového prostředí.
___
Plánujete dorazit? 🎬
___

Szukam aktorek do zagrania głównych postaci w filmie dyplomowym (non-profit)!

POSZUKIWANI:

-3 BLONDYNKI (17-25 lat)

-3 BRUNETKI (17-25 lat)

-CHŁOPAK (17-25 lat)

-DZIEWCZYNA (17-25 lat)

-PAN Z KWIATAMI (45-70 lat)

Lokalizacja: Warszawa 

Dwie przyjaciółki rozmawiają o tym co je denerwuje w kinie. Po drodze zauważają dwie dziewczyny łudząco podobne do nich, więc postanawiają je śledzić. Jadą za nimi tramwajem, obserwują do jakiej kawiarni idą, wchodzą w role szpiegów. Przysłuchując się ich rozmowom o filmach, coraz bardziej zaczynają kwestionować swoje poglądy. Czy to są ich sobowtórki?

Film będzie realizowany w eksperymentalnej konwencji zderzenia dwóch stylów filmowych. Sceny z przyjaciółkami w stylu realistycznym, natomiast z sobowtórkami -  w formalistycznym. Czas trwania: 5-10 minut. Na obrazku stylistyczne inspiracje 

To projekt dyplomowy do liceum plastycznego i z zamiarem wysyłania na festiwale.

Zainteresowanych proszę o kontakt priv lub przez ig: julkacatt - wyślę scenariusz. 

Moje prace filmowe i fotograficzne: atomosfoto na ig

Nie musisz mieć dużego doświadczenia, jeśli spodobał ci się pomysł i widzisz siebie w jednej z ról, śmiało pisz

Cześć! 😊 Szukam castingów filmowych, serialowych, reklamowych lub do różnych projektów aktorskich w Warszawie. Mam 16 lat i bardzo chciałabym spróbować swoich sił przed kamerą oraz zdobyć nowe doświadczenie.

Od 10 lat interesuję się tańcem i mam doświadczenie w różnych stylach, m.in. modern jazz i akrobatyce. Jestem otwarta na nowe wyzwania, szybko się uczę i chętnie spróbuję swoich sił również w innych projektach, np. filmach, serialach, teledyskach czy programach telewizyjnych. 🎬

Jeśli ktoś zna aktualne castingi dla osób w moim wieku w Warszawie lub okolicach, będę bardzo wdzięczna za informacje albo kontakt do osób zajmujących się rekrutacją! ❤️ Z góry dziękuję!

VI SØGER 5 DELTAGERE TIL EN YOUTUBE-VIDEO PÅ SØNDAG!
Er du god til at lyve, fortælle historier og improvisere? Så søger vi dig!

Vi er Chris & Jacob, og vi søger både drenge og piger på 18 år eller derover til en underholdende YouTube-video.

Konceptet:

Vi samler 5 deltagere, som hver især har én vild, sjov eller usædvanlig historie fra deres eget liv.

Vi har 5 forskellige historier og 5 runder, hvor vi skal forsøge at matche hver historie med den person, der rent faktisk har oplevet den.

Et eksempel på en runde:

Overskriften er: "Jeg blev fyret fra mit arbejde."

Alle 5 deltagere skal nu fortælle deres egen version af historien om dengang, de blev fyret.

Men der er et twist: Kun én af deltagerne er faktisk blevet fyret og fortæller sin sande historie. De andre 4 skal lyve og finde på deres egen overbevisende forklaring!

Chris og Jacob skal så afhøre jer, stille spørgsmål og forsøge at gennemskue, hvem der taler sandt.

Efter hver runde matcher vi historien med den person, vi tror har oplevet den. Men vi må gerne ændre vores tidligere valg undervejs, hvis en anden deltager pludselig virker mere overbevisende.

Til sidst skal vi have matchet alle 5 historier med de rigtige personer, og så afslører vi, hvor mange vi har gættet rigtigt!

Skal man kunne improvisere?

Du behøver ikke være skuespiller eller verdensmester i at lyve!

Alle deltagere får nemlig de 5 overskrifter tilsendt inden optagelsen, så I har mulighed for at forberede jeres opdigtede historier hjemmefra.

Det er altså ikke ren improvisation. Men I skal selvfølgelig stadig kunne svare på vores spørgsmål og forsøge at overbevise os om, at jeres historie er sand.

Vi søger først og fremmest nogle friske, udadvendte personer, som har lyst til at være med på kamera, kan tage lidt pis på os og ikke er bange for at spille med!

Praktisk info:

Søndag den 18. oktober
Kl. 15.00-18.00
Amager, København

Alder: 18+

Honorar:  Friviligt, ingen betaling.

Vil du være med? Det er til Chris og Jacobs youtube kanal:  [https://www.youtube.com/@ChrisogJacob](https://www.youtube.com/@ChrisogJacob)

Skriv til vores caster Mandarina på 31 49 55 65 med:

- Dit navn og din alder
- Din Instagram
- Mindst én vild, sjov, pinlig eller usædvanlig sand historie fra dit liv

Vi skal kun bruge én historie fra hver deltager til selve videoen, men du må meget gerne sende flere, så vi har noget at vælge imellem!

Det kan være alt fra en fuldstændig vanvittig oplevelse til noget virkelig akavet eller usandsynligt, som faktisk er sket for dig.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra jer!

🎬🎬🎬 MEGA ULTRA PILNE! CASTING! 🎬🎬🎬

EPIZODYSTKI I EPIZODYŚCI – ROLKI / TIKTOK / IG

Szanowni Państwo!

Na środę, 21 października 

poszukujemy epizodystek i epizodystów 

do krótkiej formy komercyjnej realizowanej 
na potrzeby kanałów TikTok i Instagram (IG).

🎥 KOGO SZUKAMY?

✅ Kobiet i mężczyzn w wieku 25–50 lat 

✅ Osób polskojęzycznych 

✅ Osób posiadających doświadczenie w pracy przed kamerą

Poszukujemy osób do wielu różnych ról, 
które wcielą się w postaci pracowników 
i klientów marketu.

💰 WYNAGRODZENIE: 500–1000 zł netto

Stawka uzależniona jest od przypisanej postaci i zakresu roli. 
Po zakwalifikowaniu zgłoszonych osób 
do konkretnych postaci skontaktujemy się 
z wybranymi osobami i poinformujemy je 
o proponowanej stawce.

📍 MIEJSCE REALIZACJI: Warszawa

📅 TERMIN: środa, 21 października 

🕘 GODZINY: pierwsza połowa dnia

📩 JAK SIĘ ZGŁOSIĆ?

Osoby zainteresowane i dyspozycyjne prosimy 
o przesłanie zgłoszenia w wiadomości e-mail 

na adres:  📧 abcastingab@gmail.com

📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭📭

W zgłoszeniu prosimy wpisać:

• Temat: ROLKI  21. 10
• Imię i nazwisko
• Wiek
• Numer telefonu
• Zdjęcie twarzy oraz zdjęcie całej sylwetki
• Informację o doświadczeniu w pracy przed kamerą
• Linki do materiałów wideo, na których można Państwa zobaczyć i usłyszeć

🎬 Poszukujemy osób do wielu postaci — jeśli masz doświadczenie przed kamerą i jesteś dyspozycyjny/a w środę, serdecznie zapraszamy do zgłoszeń!

Do zobaczenia na planie! 🎥🤝

Poszukujemy Statystów w wieku 18-70 lat (kobiety i mężczyzn) z Kielc lub okolic na plan zdjęciowy do spotu reklamowego dla znanej sieci restauracji w Kielcach w dniach 3.11, lub 4.11 (wtorek lub środa).

1. Zdjęcia w plenerze. Nagrania późnym popołudniem do nocy.

2. Wynagrodzenie za 1 dzień zdjęciowy: 150 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po planie zdjęciowym — BLIK na numer telefonu/konto bankowe).

W razie zainteresowania i dostępności w dniach 3.11 lub 4.11 prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy

5. Adres e-mail

6. Wzrost

7. Czy jest Pan/Pani dostępna/y w terminie 3.11-4.11?

8. Link do swojego profilu na Facebook/Instagram

9. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Plan zdjęciowy Kielce

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w planie zdjęciowym zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.
